Title: Azure Logic Apps updates for November and December 2019

Body.Content:
These are the new features, fixes, and connectors for Azure Logic Apps that were released in November and December of 2019.

New features and fixes

  • Support has been added for parameter tokens/authoring in the Logic Apps designer.
  • Multi-auth support has been added for the API Connection extension.
  • SQL connector now supports multi-auth/OAuth.
  • The custom connector portal extension is now available in Azure Government region.
  • An issue where Logic Apps didn’t show run details for actions with an “until” loop nested inside a “foreach” loop has been fixed.
  • The SFTP-SSH connector now provides an option to create a connection to subfolders in the root folder.

New GA connectors

  • SQL with Azure Active Directory support

New connectors

  • Cloudmersive Data Validation
  • KnowledgeLake
  • Egnyte
  • Witivio
  • Cisco Webex Meetings
  • Partner Center Events
  • docQ - Generate Documents
  • EXPOCAD
  • EXPOCAD EDGE Web API Service
  • Telephony Xtended Service Interface
  • Cloudmersive Image Processing
  • Robolytix
  • Priority Matrix
  • Azure Cognitive Services Content Moderator (Azure Government)
  • Azure Cognitive Services Custom Vision (Azure Government)
  • Adobe Sign (Azure Government)
